name: veterinary_clinic_system_037_vaccine_stock_shrink
instruction: Stock-shrink adjustment: an audit found every location's vaccine stock (item_name containing 'vaccine', case-sensitive) overcounted. Reduce each such row's quantity_on_hand by ops_meta.shrink_pct PERCENT (round DOWN to whole units), and add field shrink_adjusted='<batch_code>'. Non-vaccine rows must remain byte-identical.
